card.name: Verbs for examining the patient
card.fires_on: The verb 'evaluate' (or 'examined') right after 'discontinue [drug] and' in warning text about rash, fever or other signs. It also fires on 'examined' in 'the patient should be examined'.

modes.label: Evaluate after discontinue
modes.description: 'evaluate' follows 'discontinue [drug name] and' in a hypersensitivity warning.
modes.example: If such signs or symptoms are present, discontinue OXAPROZIN CAPSULES and<< evaluate>> the patient immediately. 5.1

modes.label: Patient should be examined
modes.description: 'examined' follows 'the patient should be' in a super-infection warning.
modes.example: Whenever clinical judgment dictates, the patient should be<< examined>> with the aid of magnification, such

card.writes: It seems to push toward verbs of finding or checking, but the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
